scraped_replies.html: Do other interrupts work in your projects? Systick for one?
scraped_replies.author: Pavel A.

scraped_replies.html: All other interrupts work. I have a UART that works with interrupts. I launched the TouchGFX project on the same PCB where the LTDC interrupts are. Now I was supposed to add a touch controller that uses EXTI. But EXTI didn't work, so I created a clean project with just EXTI to find the error... but so far I can't find it. I uploaded the same code to three other MCUs: the H743, H563, and H750, and it worked on all of them. Considering that in the previous version, the STM32CubeMX ST had a rather serious bug with the STM32H743ZIT6, preventing it from setting the clock to 480MHz, which has been reported by many users on the forum, I wonder if a bug hasn't crept in here too...
